question: 有机化学·Reaction Learn 命名反应学习卡：请用文字概述该反应的主要转化：Chan–Lam coupling。 来源卡片给出的代表性条件：Cu(OAc)₂, pyridine, CH₂Cl₂, air, rt。
answer: Cu-mediated coupling of an aryl boronic acid with an N–H or O–H compound, in air at room temperature.
explanation: 来源补充说明（未专家审核）：The oxidative counterpart of the Buchwald–Hartwig reaction.
